question: Plot salary trend by joining date as a line chart
sql:
SELECT employees.joining_date, employees.salary AS employees_salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY employees.joining_date ASC

question: Show all employees
sql: SELECT employees.id AS emp_id, employees.name AS emp_name, employees.department AS emp_department, employees.salary AS emp_salary, employees.joining_date AS emp_joining_date, employees.city AS emp_city, employees.department_id AS emp_department_id FROM employees JOIN departments AS dept ON employees.department_id = dept.id

question: Show salary distribution as a histogram
sql:
SELECT salary AS employees.salary, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM employees
GROUP BY salary
ORDER BY salary ASC
LIMIT 100000000

question: Show salary distribution as a histogram
sql:
SELECT salary AS e_salary, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM employees
GROUP BY e_salary
ORDER BY e_salary ASC

question: Visualize employees per city as a pie chart
sql:
SELECT city, SUM(salary) AS total_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY total_salary DESC
LIMIT 0, 1000
